description: Search the professional skippers a guest can request, with or without a boat booked, by the region they work in, the boat type they skipper, the dates they are free, and the language, licences, personality and rules they list. `total_matching` is the full count; `skippers` holds the first `limit`. With dates, only skippers free on every day of the stay are listed. `price` is what the guest pays for that skipper, charged on its own and never part of a boat's total: `per_day`, and with dates `total` for the `days` of the stay. It is not the skipper fee a boat lists itself. A skipper is always a request the skipper answers, made from their profile, so give the `url` to the profile, never a promise that a named skipper can be booked.

boat_type.description: Optional: only skippers of a boat model or make of this type.

currency.description: Optional: the currency every amount in the answer is written in, and any price you send is read in. When the conversation has its own currency, that one is used whatever is sent; otherwise the one sent, EUR when omitted.

date_from.description: Optional check-in date YYYY-MM-DD of the boat stay.

date_to.description: Optional check-out date YYYY-MM-DD of the boat stay.

language.description: Optional: only skippers who speak this language.

licences.description: Optional: only skippers holding every licence listed, each one checked by us and not expired.

location.description: Place as the guest says it, resolved to real locations; a place that resolves to nothing returns `location_unresolved` and no skippers, never skippers somewhere else.

personality.description: Optional: only skippers who describe themselves with every trait listed.

rules.description: Optional: only skippers who keep every rule listed.

name: search_skippers
title: Find Professional Skippers
